title: Fukrey 3
desc: The Fukras dream of ruling Delhi and contesting elections, but with no money, they take up an international job for quick cash-setting off a wild adventure that changes their lives.

title: Shirdi Ke Sai Baba
desc: A doctor visits Shirdi with his ailing son, torn between faith and science. To save his child, he must decide if Sai Baba's blessings hold the cure he desperately seeks.

title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
desc: In Bareilly, free-spirited Bitti defies marriage pressures until her life changes when she meets Chirag and Pritam, sparking unexpected adventures and romance.

title: Saagar
desc: Raja secretly loves Mona, but she loves Ravi. Ravi's grandmother disapproves, forcing Mona to choose between love and family, leaving Raja heartbroken yet hopeful.

title: Khatta Meetha
desc: Sachin, a contractor, sues the Satara Municipal Corporation for unpaid dues. His ex-girlfriend, now the commissioner, seeks revenge while a bridge collapse and legal troubles escalate his problems.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: A commoner named Prem swaps places with Prince Vijay Singh before a tense coronation. As plots unfold, Princess Maithili, meant to wed Vijay, finds herself drawn to Prem.

title: Gadar-Ek Prem Katha
desc: During the partition, Tara marries Sakina, living happily together. Their joy ends when Sakina's father forces her to remain in Pakistan, separating her from Tara and her family forever.

title: Vedha
desc: A vigilante father seeks justice for his daughter, leading a brutal yet poignant journey of revenge and redemption that questions the line between justice, violence, and healing.

title: Jeete Hai Shaan Se
desc: Friends Johny, Govinda, and Iqbal work to serve their community, but when tensions rise between Johny and Govinda, Iqbal intervenes before their greatest enemy exploits the rift.

title: Prem Rog
desc: Shunned after her husband's death, Manorama finds hope in Deodhar, her childhood friend, who challenges societal norms to restore her dignity and help her rebuild her life.

title: Shubh Mangal Saavdhan
desc: Mudit, a shy boy, wins Sugandha's heart and plans marriage. But their relationship faces turmoil when they discover his erectile dysfunction, challenging their love before the wedding.

title: Andaz Apna Apna
desc: Two ambitious rivals chase wealth by pursuing an heiress, but their plans spiral into confusion when a family plot and hidden identity create unexpected trouble.

title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
desc: Tara and Sitara, thieves, hide in Major Ram Singh's house. When Cobra kidnaps their mother, they must deceive Ram to save her and free Panther.

title: Bachchhan Paandey
desc: Myra picks dreaded gangster Bachchhan Paandey as the subject of her film, but her plan spirals when the terrifying hooligan decides he wants to star in the movie himself.

title: Phata Poster Nikla Hero
desc: Vishwas dreams of stardom, but to please his mother and impress Kajal, he pretends to be a policeman-only to land himself in a whirlwind of chaos and trouble.

title: Happy Phirr Bhag Jayegi
desc: Harpreet travels to China to find her fiance but is kidnapped by mistake. The thugs had meant to take someone else with the same name.
